description: This file defines the OA_phpAdsNew class, which handles upgrade and configuration migration tasks for OpenX/Revive Adserver, including reading configuration files, database interactions, and GeoIP data processing.

classes.name: OA_phpAdsNew
classes.description: Class for upgrading and migrating configuration of OpenX/Revive Adserver, including reading config files, database queries, and GeoIP data handling.

methods.name: init
methods.description: Initializes configuration by reading existing config and setting up database connection.

methods.name: getPANversion
methods.description: Retrieves the configuration version from the database.

methods.name: _getPANConfig
methods.description: Reads and parses the configuration file, returning the config array.

methods.name: _migratePANConfig
methods.description: Converts old config array to new format.

methods.name: renamePANConfigFile
methods.description: Renames the existing config file with a backup prefix.

methods.name: checkPANConfigIntegrity
methods.description: Checks the integrity of the configuration, especially geotargeting settings.

methods.name: phpAds_geoip_getConf
methods.description: Reads and serializes GeoIP database info.

methods.name: phpAds_geoip_get_info
methods.description: Extracts GeoIP database info from a file pointer.

methods.name: phpPgAdsIndexToOpenads
methods.description: Converts an index to an Openads table index with prefix.

methods.name: phpPgAdsPrefixedIndex
methods.description: Creates a prefixed index string for database.
